name: Cerebrum
short_description: The largest part of the brain, responsible for higher-level cognitive functions.

name: Cerebellum
short_description: Located at the back of the brain, responsible for motor control and coordination.

name: Brainstem
short_description: Connects the brain to the spinal cord, controlling basic life functions.

name: Frontal Lobe
short_description: The front region of the cerebrum associated with reasoning, planning, and voluntary movement.

name: Parietal Lobe
short_description: Located behind the frontal lobe; responsible for sensory perception and spatial awareness.

name: Temporal Lobe
short_description: Located on the sides of the brain; involved in auditory processing and memory.

name: Occipital Lobe
short_description: Located at the back of the brain; responsible for visual processing.

name: Medulla Oblongata
short_description: Part of the brainstem that controls vital functions like heart rate and breathing.
